extName.description: Extension name in the toolbar, popup, and Chrome Web Store.

extDescription.message: Turns webpage text into synthetic glyphs that look like characters but do not exist. Local only.
extDescription.description: Store summary and manifest description. Maximum 132 characters.

enabled.description: Label for the on/off switch in the popup.

intensity.description: Label for the intensity slider in the popup.

preview.description: Heading above the live glyph preview.

levelSlight.description: Intensity name when the value is below 25.

levelClear.description: Intensity name when the value is from 25 to 49.

levelHeavy.description: Intensity name when the value is from 50 to 79.

levelMax.description: Intensity name when the value is 80 or above.

intensityValue.description: Slider readout: the numeric intensity and its short name.
